metadata.about: The app's own outdoor map style, on OpenFreeMap's OpenMapTiles vector tiles. Shipped inside the app; edit with Maputnik. The app replaces the label expression with one for its language (MapStyles). A few rules (e.g. the road number signs) follow OpenMapTiles' OSM Bright style: (c) MapTiler.com & OpenMapTiles contributors, (c) Mapbox; code BSD 3-Clause, design CC BY 4.0.
